final: SELECT project_id, funding_source, project_avg, project_avg - funding_avg AS difference FROM (SELECT project_id, funding_source, project_avg, AVG(project_avg) OVER (PARTITION BY funding_source) AS funding_avg FROM (SELECT p.arcregistry AS project_id, p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG(CAST(s.boxx AS REAL) / NULLIF(CAST(s.boxz AS REAL), 0)) AS project_avg FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.arcregistry, p.fundflux)) WHERE project_avg > funding_avg ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
